extracted text: The paper studies the microstructural features and casting defects of high-pressure die-cast (HPDC) AlSi9Cu3(Fe) alloy (EN AB-46000, equivalent to the US designation A380). The alloy was produced through aluminum scrap recovery and die-cast specimens were stored at room temperature for about 5 months before analysis, making them similar to a T1 condition. This temper designation applies to products cooled from an elevated-temperature shaping process and for which mechanical properties have been stabilized by room temperature aging. The study examines tensile specimens with different gage diameters (6.0 mm, 3.4 mm, and 3.0 mm) to evaluate microstructural variations and mechanical properties.
